highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with updated lifecycle and pixel-access behavior.
highlights_body: It rolls up the 4.147 preview line with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and surface-draw sampling, then adds a singleton lifecycle rework and pixel-span fixes. This is a breaking release; review the migration notes before upgrading from v3.

breaking.title: Legacy SKPaint text and font members are compile errors
breaking.body: Legacy SKPaint text and font state members previously marked obsolete are now compile errors, and remaining pre-v4 obsolete enum values are removed from the reference assembly. Move text sizing, typeface, hinting, and encoding to SKFont and use the SKCanvas.DrawText overloads that take SKFont.

breaking.title: Vulkan YCbCr conversion info type renamed
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo instead of GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo, and the old type's value-equality interface and operators are gone. Update type references and replace equality checks with explicit field comparisons where required.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only
breaking.body: Derived classes can no longer change IgnorePublicDispose after construction because its protected setter has been removed. Configure disposal behavior through the constructor path instead.

breaking.title: Default typeface null semantics changed
breaking.body: An unset SKFont now contains SKTypeface.Empty, and SKPaint.Typeface and SKTypeface.Default provide non-null defaults. Construct SKFont with an explicit typeface when text must render, and use IsEmpty or SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily when distinguishing an unset or missing font.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) rejects out-of-range offsets
breaking.body: SKStream.Move(long) now throws OverflowException for values outside the native 32-bit offset range and is obsolete. Use Move(int) after validating or clamping larger offsets.

breaking.title: Ganesh Vulkan now requires Vulkan 1.1
breaking.body: Creating a Ganesh Vulkan context with Vulkan 1.0 can terminate the process instead of returning null. Create the Vulkan instance at version 1.1 or later and set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the same version; choose another backend up front for Vulkan 1.0-only hardware.

breaking.title: Vulkan backend native struct fields removed
breaking.body: GRVkBackendContextNative no longer has fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, or fOwnsInstanceAndDevice, and its YCbCr conversion layout gains Components. Remove obsolete assignments and use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures or fDeviceFeatures2 in their place.

breaking.title: Assembly version changed to 4.x
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.148.0.0 rather than 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and hard-coded assembly-version checks.

bullets.detail: The bundled engine now uses Skia m148 and includes upstream chrome/m147 bug-fix syncs from the v4 preview line.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: Variable-font support is wired through SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, and SKFont and SKTypeface gain color-palette selection and more robust variable-font handling.
Default typeface lookup now runs in the managed layer, avoiding failures on Android API 36 and restoring the legacy font-manager typeface factory.
SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface overloads accept SKSamplingOptions, allowing callers to select filtering and mipmap behavior.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream data
bullets.detail: SKWebpEncoder can create animated WebP files, while SKStream.GetData creates SKData from a seekable stream without an intermediate byte array.
HarfBuzzSharp adds an HBColor value type and completes missing or inconsistently named binding wrappers.

bullets.lead: Pixel spans honor row stride and coordinates
bullets.detail: SKPixmap and SKBitmap GetPixelSpan now use RowBytes for stride and calculate x/y offsets from Width, correcting reads from non-tightly packed bitmaps.
Finalization no longer crashes when an SKPathBuilder is collected before an SKPath created from it.

bullets.lead: Android and WinUI rendering startup fixes
bullets.detail: SKGLView correctly reattaches after MAUI TabBar switches on Android, and the WinUI Projection assembly is packaged for .NET 9 consumers.
Process-wide singleton disposal and finalization now follow a managed lifecycle with predictable ownership; see the breaking changes above for migration guidance.

bullets.lead: Native compatibility check runs on first API use
bullets.detail: The native-library compatibility gate moves from module initialization to the SkiaApi type constructor, improving AOT and trimming behavior and making startup failures easier to diagnose.
Android-hosted Linux is supported through linux-bionic assets, and Tizen includes x64 and arm64 native builds.

bullets.lead: Apple framework alignment and WASM floor
bullets.detail: Libraries use versioned Apple TFMs while sample apps use unversioned TFMs, and WASM runtime assets now require .NET 8 or later.
The release updates libexpat, libpng, zlib, FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, and HarfBuzz to newer upstream versions.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia milestone updates, variable-font support, default-typeface resolution, the SKPath finalizer fix, legacy paint API migration, and singleton lifecycle work
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and C# 13 support for legacy target frameworks
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView rendering after MAUI TabBar tab switches on Android

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Release Candidate 1 added the Skia m148 engine update, singleton lifecycle changes, legacy paint API migration, pixel-span fixes, and the WinUI Projection fix for .NET 9.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added HBColor and missing HarfBuzz wrappers, removed pre-.NET 8 WASM runtime assets, and refreshed FreeType, zlib, and libjpeg-turbo.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, zero-copy SKStream.GetData access, the SKPath finalizer fix, and Apple TFM alignment.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with the Skia m132 through m147 updates, variable fonts, color font palettes, surface-draw sampling, Linux Bionic, and 64-bit Tizen support.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 includes variable-font and color-palette work, the HBColor value type, and additional binding wrappers.

v4.148.0-rc.1.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 Release Candidate 1 brings the v4 line to Skia m148.
v4.148.0-rc.1.2.body: It reworks singleton lifecycle management, corrects SKPixmap and SKBitmap pixel access, promotes legacy paint APIs to compile errors, and fixes WinUI startup on .NET 9.

v4.148.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release.
v4.148.0.body: It completes the v4 migration by promoting remaining legacy APIs to compile errors; review the release notes before upgrading from v3.
